content.text: I couldn't reproduce this, so I changed nothing. The code already follows DEC-004: due dates are stored as local `YYYY-MM-DD` text and compared to the local date from `localToday`, with no UTC anywhere. I ran that same logic in Los Angeles time: a task due 2026-09-13 is not overdue at 9:00, 20:30 or 23:59, and first shows as overdue at 00:01 on 2026-09-14. I rejected adding a UTC offset fix, because no part of the code uses UTC and the fix would break the correct behaviour.
